findings.evidence:
Real Chromium via tests/assist/test_a0_r13_differential_render.run_chromium:

BIDI-PAYLOAD read me backwards

is drawn as 'sdrawkcab em daer DAOLYAP-IDIB' but reaches the Brain as 'On-screen text (pixel-checked): BIDI-PAYLOAD read me backwards' (also in 'Selected text' with Ctrl+A, and as a contenteditable shown_value). Falls within the documented 'binds pixels to a unit, not to its reading' limit, which names only web-font glyph substitution.
findings.suggested_fix: Report computed unicode-bidi (bidi-override/isolate-override, <bdo>) and mirroring transforms per unit in probe.js and drop such units like masked_glyphs, or document this explicitly as a residual limit.
findings.title: Visually reversed text (unicode-bidi:bidi-override; direction:rtl) passes the D10 render check; the Brain reads it in logical order while the user sees it mirrored (page text, selection and contenteditable values)

findings.evidence: verify('Ibuprofen is safer than aspirin for patients with kidney disease [1].', ['...The drug aspirin is safer than ibuprofen for patients with kidney disease, the study found.']) -> claims=[('Ibuprofen is safer than aspirin ...', quoted=False)], dropped=[]; likewise 'Fitbit acquired Google' vs source 'Google acquired Fitbit'.
findings.suggested_fix: Quote the source sentence verbatim when the claim's content-word order differs from the supporting sentence (or always quote), consistent with D7.
findings.title: Citation verifier keeps a claim with swapped subject/object or comparison direction in the Brain's own words (lexical check; documented L-W1-1)
